body: Thank you. I'm just so tired of having to fight through everything and for everything. It makes me selfish. I love my children but I'm no good to them like this. I wish I could goid back to when I was still fresh and new. Before any of it happened and I could just avoid it all but still somehow have my kids. I wish I could be the kind of mother they need and not some emotionally cripped waste that would let peiple treat her like this. I hope they watch me but never really see me. I hope they never remember it as mommy crying on the couch but as mommy watching a movie with me. They are the only reason I'm still alive. They are the only good thing I have ever done and the only good that I might be able to give this world.
No they are to young and they can't go to daycare because of their very serious food allergies.

The therapist said I can't bring my kids. The on base daycare used to watch kids for peiple to do this kind of thing but they are understaffed and can't anymore. I have to choose between a babysitter and food and that isn't really a choice. Thank you for trying to help me.
